name: Penban
description: Penban is the kanban board for everyone who prefers to think with a pen. Instead of typing tasks into forms, write and sketch directly on your cards with a stylus — like sticky notes, only neatly sorted. Shape recognition, lasso selection, a text mode, full-text search (typed and handwritten), local storage and .penban export/import. Free on the Microsoft Store and App Store with an optional one-time Pro unlock.
author: Agredo Application
